scientific_summary: MusiCoT trains a single text-conditioned semantic LM on coarse-first CLAP RVQ thought tokens followed by audio tokens. CLAP embeddings of 10-second clips yield analyzable intermediate musical thoughts.
invariants: Thoughts are continuous CLAP embeddings represented by RVQ tokens, not natural-language reasoning.
For M clips and L codebooks, flatten all M tokens of level 1, then level 2, through level L; do not flatten clip by clip.
LM predicts thought tokens before audio tokens; training uses CE for both token domains.
Dual temperatures T₁/T₂ and CFG scales λ₁/λ₂ belong to thought/audio domains, respectively.
CLAP internals and fixed/trainable flags are not specified in the supplied excerpt; do not invent them. RVQ is trained by reconstruction quantization loss.
Analysis reconstructs quantized CLAP vectors and compares cosine similarity to relevant text anchors; heatmap is schematic, not experiment data.
Diagram output stops at audio tokens, as supplied Methodology; do not invent a direct CLAP audio decoder.
layout: RECTANGLE FIRST, MOSTLY ONE-WAY SECOND. Landscape 1800×1150 white canvas. Exactly four aligned bands fill one complete rectangular footprint x50..1750: band 1 Music Audio, CLAP, RVQ (RVQ spans two columns); band 2 Text Tokens, Dual Sampling, Semantic LM (LM spans two columns); band 3 Musical Thoughts spans the whole width as one shallow token sequence; band 4 two equal-width outputs Audio Tokens and Structural Analysis. Thus no empty cells, protruding cards, diagonal staircase or unbalanced blank half. Macro flow follows rightward training then downward generation: Audio→CLAP→RVQ, RVQ↓LM↓Thoughts↓the two outputs. Text and Sampling use short distinct overhead feeder lanes into LM. Every scientific arrowhead points right or down, none left or up. Vertical movement within short local feeder lanes is acceptable to keep the rectangular composition. No outer return bus. Never force all heads right at the expense of the silhouette. Dark bold plain headings, pale violet content surfaces, amber only for RVQ. No filled title strips. Preserve actual waveform as a direct-content inset: leave [75,188,300,108] clean white inside Music Audio, no text/marks drawn inside.
typography: Arial or a coherent clean sans serif. Bold black/dark headings on unpainted background; scientific interior fill only. Short readable labels, no gray microcopy, no visible underscore, mathematical indices genuinely typeset. Reserve labels away from shafts.
